result.email_draft:
Subject: Currency Confirmation Required for Invoice MA-8014

Dear Accounts Receivable Team,

Regarding our purchase order PO-2026-1014, invoice MA-8014 dated October 7, 2026, for a total of USD 1,280.00, is currently on hold.

The invoice currency differs from the purchase order and our vendor master records. The invoice is issued in USD, while both the purchase order and our records for Milano Arredi S.r.l. indicate EUR as the correct currency.

Please confirm the correct currency for invoice MA-8014. If EUR is correct, kindly issue a credit note for the current invoice and provide a corrected invoice in EUR.

Kind regards,
